test_log_effective_sample_size: test the log_effective_sample_size function with equal and arbitrary unnormalized log weights
test_simple_resampling: test the simple_resampling function by verifying empirical mean and variance match target values
test_optionally_resample: test the optionally_resample function with lower and upper ESS thresholds to verify conditional resampling
test_tree_resampling: test the simple_resampling function with nested JAX tree structures containing -inf log weights
run_resampling_tests: run the ResamplingTest test suite using absltest to validate all resampling functions
